perks: Puzzles drawn from your own mistakes

profs.title: Three personalities, one obsession: your progress.

hero.lead: Build your chess training, move by move.

modules.title: Each module has its own color, prof and settings.
modules.lead: Duration, Elo, themes, color played, per-move clock, spaced repetition: you set it up, we keep it going.

woodpecker.title: The same set, faster every time.
woodpecker.lead: Solve your set, then start over in shorter and shorter cycles. The grid keeps track of every puzzle: fast, solved, with help or missed.

steps.composeText: A title, a cover, then your modules in whatever order you like.
steps.trainText: Your prof slips you a tip, a hint or the solution when you get stuck.
steps.progressText: Every puzzle leaves a trace. Mistakes come back until they become reflexes.

auto.title: Your games work for you.
auto.quote: Connect your Lichess account: I read your games and prepare training that suits you.
auto.repertoireText: We keep the moves you actually play, opening by opening, and show you where you win and where you lose.
auto.sessionText: We read your last 200 games: your openings, your endgames, the advantages you let slip. Your session of the day comes out of it.
auto.note: Early access: an invitation key is required to sign up. Already signed up with Lichess? You go straight to the generation.
